notes: mandated_share = part of the fall in trade with Russia against the 2018-2021 average (goods) or 2018-2019 average (services), measured at pre-war prices, that bans required; own choice = 1 - mandated_share. to_rus = goods bought from Russia (map: 'less paid to Russia'), from_rus = goods sold to Russia ('sales to Russia given up'), svc_bought / svc_sold = services. Per product: mandated = min(fall of that product, pre-war value x share of the year the ban was in force x share of the product it covers); total fall includes all products (gas too). Low/high vary the in-force date (end of wind-down vs adoption), partial ('ex') codes, quotas, the pipeline share of German and Polish crude, and the national service-ban coverage. Share is capped at 1 when banned goods fell by more than the total (other trade grew, e.g. LNG); null when there was no fall. mandated_eurbn is the mandated fall in EUR bn at pre-war prices from customs data; mandated_share_map divides it by the map's own fall (site/data.json as of 2026-10-18, with transit gas and trend adjustments) and is the safer number to apply to the map. gas_part = share of the import fall that is natural gas (not sanctioned before April 2026; part of it was cut by Gazprom or by the end of transit through Ukraine, not chosen by the buyer). 2026 = January-August.
